I'd steer you away from it. DMAA is a stimulant that's banned in many countries and prohibited by most sports organizations, and it has been pulled or flagged by regulators like the FDA because of cardiovascular concerns. Any supplement that lists it is a red flag about the product, not just the ingredient.

For what a preworkout is supposed to do, a solid meal beforehand, good sleep, and a proper warm-up carry far more than any stimulant. If you want to use a supplement, a doctor or registered dietitian is the right person to tell you what's appropriate for you, and I can't give amounts for any of it.

If you're hitting a wall in your sessions, tell me where it's showing up and I'll look at your training.
